test_title: PYST 62: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Priya starts from point A and drives 9 km towards North. She then takes a right turn, drives 4 km to reach point B. She then turns right, drives 10 km and stops at point C. In which direction is point C with respect to point A?
solution:
**Given:**

Priya starts from point A and drives 9 km towards North.

She then takes a right turn, drives 4 km to reach point B.

She then turns right, drives 10 km and stops at point C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d035a86a36db08a44933f3c068eb8cc8e42ee0abe838555afeed8c7ca578d488.png] 

Thus, Point C is in the southeast direction with respect to point A.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
